map.50mm、f/4、对焦 3m：H=f²/(N·c)+f≈20.88m，近界限 2: 50mm, f/4, focus 3m: H=f^2/(N c)+f ~ 20.88m, near limit 2.63m, far limit 3.49m => front DOF 0.37m, back DOF 0.49m, total 0.87m (shallow, good for bokeh); stop to f/11 extends total to ~2.75m.
map.同 50mm f/4 对焦 1m：近界限 0.96m、远界限 1.05m ⇒ 总: Same 50mm f/4 focus 1m: near limit 0.96m, far limit 1.05m => total DOF only ~0.09m, extremely shallow; closer focus, narrower DOF.
map.远界限减近界限，等于前景深（对焦点到最近清晰点）加后景深（对焦点到最远清晰点）；: Far limit minus near limit equals front DOF (focus to nearest sharp) plus back DOF (focus to farthest sharp); closer focus and wider aperture shrink total DOF, the core of bokeh control.
